title: The 7 Habits Of Highly Effective People

questions.q: What is the funeral test meant to clarify?
a: The person you want to be remembered as
Which friends deserve more of your time
How productive your career has been
What your family expects from you
questions.why: Lesson 1 has you imagine your funeral to reveal your real priorities.

questions.q: What does the ladder analogy warn against?
a: Climbing efficiently toward the wrong goal
Working without a supportive team
Stopping before reaching the top
Choosing a ladder that is too tall
questions.why: Lesson 1 says efficiency only helps when you are headed in the right direction.

questions.q: What does the summary say about important and urgent tasks?
a: They often do not overlap, so some tasks deserve a no
They usually arrive together and demand action
Urgent tasks are generally the most valuable
Important tasks should always be done first
questions.why: Lesson 2 notes the important is rarely urgent, which means saying no to much.

questions.q: What does active listening involve, per the summary?
a: Listening to understand rather than to reply
Taking notes so you can answer precisely
Nodding while you plan your response
Offering advice as soon as possible
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists understanding, mirroring and helping people structure their thoughts.

questions.q: Why does the summary compare quick advice to antibiotics?
a: People distrust help offered before they feel understood
Fast cures usually create worse problems later
Experts should treat only serious complaints
Too much help makes people dependent on you
questions.why: Lesson 3 says we doubt people who prescribe before they have really listened.
